apropos.s1.p1: I work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, automation, No-Code and digital product creation. My approach is simple: an idea only has value once it becomes a working system.
apropos.s1.p2: I don't build "to show off". I build things I use, test in real conditions, and evolve based on results.
apropos.s2.p1: DIGICRAFT Labs is where this approach takes shape: a personal digital laboratory where complex ideas are broken down, prototyped and turned into useful systems.
apropos.s2.p2: Automations, AI agents, Telegram bots, digital products: every project is an experiment — and every experiment leads to concrete proof of what works.
apropos.s3.p1: Assistants that handle emails instead of humans, bots that write and summarise, narrative games that adapt in real time: I build systems that answer a precise need and run on their own.
apropos.s4.p1: I don't look for the most impressive technology — I look for the most suitable one. A simple workflow that runs beats a complex architecture that breaks.
apropos.s4.p2g: enough to grow with the need.
apropos.s7.p1: I regularly publish my experiments, methods and findings on LinkedIn. That is where you will see the lab in action.
